content: The tag shall consist of • reserved (Bit 7 of the first byte) • wire type (Bit 6-4 of the first byte) • Data ID (Bit 3-0 of the first byte and bit 7-0 of the second byte) Bit 7 is the highest significant bit of a byte, bit 0 is the lowest significant bit of a byte.
